issues.text: New wording (round 2) attributes the waiting to the tracking flag alone. The RabbitMQ.Client 7.2.2 XML doc for PublisherConfirmationTrackingEnabled says only "Should this library track publisher confirmations for you?" and describes the sequence-number header; the .NET tutorial says the await returns once confirmed, without tying it to that flag. Claim 5 covers "confirmations and tracking on" together, not the flag by itself.
issues.quote: Line 49 turns publisher confirms on, and the tracking flag makes each publish wait for its confirm;
issues.fix: Replace with: "Line 49 turns publisher confirms on and lets the client track each confirm for you; with both on, `BasicPublishAsync`, which `PublishAsync` calls earlier in the file, completes only once RabbitMQ has confirmed the message."
